coverage.subtopic: NKCC2 blockade and loss of the medullary concentration gradient
coverage.learning_objective: NKCC2 blockade in the thick ascending limb reduces the medullary concentration gradient and the lumen-positive voltage that normally supports paracellular calcium and magnesium reabsorption.

coverage.subtopic: Efferent arteriolar dependence on angiotensin II in bilateral renal artery stenosis
coverage.learning_objective: In bilateral renal artery stenosis, glomerular filtration becomes dependent on angiotensin II-mediated efferent arteriolar constriction; ACE inhibition can therefore sharply reduce GFR.

coverage.subtopic: Renal ammoniagenesis and new bicarbonate generation
coverage.learning_objective: Renal compensation for chronic respiratory acidosis requires increased ammonium excretion, titratable acid excretion, bicarbonate reabsorption, and new bicarbonate generation.

coverage.topic: Chronic kidney disease-mineral and bone disorder
coverage.subtopic: Phosphate retention, calcitriol deficiency, and secondary hyperparathyroidism
coverage.learning_objective: CKD causes phosphate retention and reduced calcitriol production, leading to hypocalcemic signaling and secondary hyperparathyroidism.

coverage.subtopic: Loss of elastic recoil and expiratory flow limitation in emphysema
coverage.learning_objective: Emphysema causes expiratory flow limitation through loss of elastic recoil and radial airway traction, producing dynamic small-airway collapse and a concave expiratory flow-volume loop.

coverage.subtopic: Surfactant deficiency, surface tension, and reduced compliance
coverage.learning_objective: Surfactant deficiency in premature infants increases alveolar surface tension, raises opening pressure, decreases compliance, and promotes atelectasis.

coverage.subtopic: Reduced oxygen content and impaired unloading despite normal arterial oxygen tension
coverage.learning_objective: Carbon monoxide poisoning reduces oxygen-carrying capacity and impairs oxygen unloading while arterial PO2 may remain normal and conventional pulse oximetry may appear reassuring.

coverage.subtopic: High V/Q units and increased alveolar dead space
coverage.learning_objective: Pulmonary embolism creates ventilated but underperfused alveoli with a high V/Q ratio and increased physiologic dead space.
